lines.en: I hop from flagstone to flagstone.
Stone legs land loud.
We go in a row, a whole pack.
I walk beside statues, like kin.
Gravel grows in my cracks.

lines.zh: 我从墙头跳到另一个墙头。
lines.en: I leap from one wall top to the next.
I clatter as I walk.
I circle a silverfish's hole.
I shove the stone in my path aside.

lines.zh: 同行的几只跟着我的步子。
lines.en: The others match my step.

lines.zh: 我从石像鬼的影子里出来。
lines.en: I come out of a gargoyle's shadow.
I move slowly, but with weight.
I stop to sniff a crack in the stone.
My shoulder cracks against the door frame.
I work my way along the roof ridge.
My tail sweeps off a layer of dust.

lines.zh: 我选定一个位置，蹲下来。
lines.en: I pick a spot and crouch.

lines.zh: 我从高处往下看着队伍。
lines.en: I watch the pack from above.
I crouch like a stone.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，发出低低的响。
lines.en: I open my mouth and rumble low.
The smell of silverfish is near.

lines.zh: 我等着谁从我下面走过。
lines.en: I wait for someone to pass beneath me.

lines.zh: 同行的几只挤在我旁边。
lines.en: The others crowd beside me.
I fear pickaxes. Don't bring one out.

lines.zh: 我的石头皮肤在阳光下很暖。
lines.en: My stone skin is warm in the sun.

lines.zh: 我是从石像鬼里出来的。
lines.en: I came out of a gargoyle.

lines.zh: 我抬起爪子，看它有没有裂。
lines.en: I lift a claw to check for cracks.
I grind my teeth, coarse and low.

lines.zh: 我可以被收进兜里，你知道吧。
lines.en: I can be pocketed, you know.

lines.zh: 我往那边一坐，别的生物就跑了。
lines.en: When I sit there, other creatures flee.
You don't have a pickaxe, do you?

lines.zh: 我蹲在你上面，你看不见我。
lines.en: I crouch above you. You can't see me.
Your companions already ran.
I don't eat people, but I do scare them.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是自己磨出来的。
lines.en: My eyes are ground into shape.
You stand steady. Not afraid of stone.
You don't smell of silverfish.
You dare look at me while I sit like this?
Step back and I'll come down.
A chip falls off my stone skin.
I step back and grit flies.
That rang in my head.
My crack has widened.
I don't cry out; I only grunt.
I can still crouch. Not broken.
Doesn't your hand hurt?
I shake and dust falls everywhere.
This much is nothing.
I right myself.

lines.zh: 虫子的味道才让我抬头。
lines.en: Only the smell of insects lifts my head.
I can't bite what you're holding.
I'm not truly a gargoyle.
Put it away. I'm not hungry.
I'm only interested in bugs.
That won't fit in my cracks.
Coaxing a rock? Useless.
I sneer and stone chips fall.
You hit me like a millstone.
Not one soft part on me.
Your hand must be numb.

lines.zh: 我从上面落下来，正合我意。
lines.en: I drop right onto you. Just what I wanted.

lines.zh: 我坐在你背上，你就动不了。
lines.en: Once I sit on your back, you can't move.
Don't push; I'm heavier than you think.
My grit rubs all over you.
I lost my grip and rolled.
Done, I crouch as before.

lines.zh: 你踩我一脚，我连头都没低。
lines.en: You step on me; I don't even lower my head.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，像一堆砖。
lines.en: We bunch up like a stack of bricks.

lines.zh: 好几只凑在一起，像石堆。
lines.en: Several of us gather like a pile of rocks.
We knock our heads together.
They rumble low, in unison.

lines.zh: 我们一起把蠹虫的窝翻了。
lines.en: Together we turn over a silverfish nest.

lines.zh: 石头与石头之间，也有交情。
lines.en: Stone has its friendships too.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一团，睡在墙头。
lines.en: We huddle and sleep on the wall.
There's an order to who strikes first.
They block the wind for me.
At dawn we scatter.
Next time lightning strikes, we gather again.
I pick up something shiny in my jaws.
I claw at it for a while.
This one's better than the one in my mouth.
I keep the pearl in a crack.
I turn over the dropped things.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬了一下，没咬动。
lines.en: I bite it. Won't give.
Stone likes bright things.
I hide it in the rubble.
Done, I crouch again.
I've taken a liking to this spot of yours.
I'm coming down off the wall.
I open my mouth. That's my laugh.
You're in my way.

lines.zh: 我不吃你，我只是想吓你。
lines.en: I won't eat you; I just want to scare you.
The silverfish are that way. Clearing first.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经动了。
lines.en: By the time you look up, I've moved.
This stretch belongs to a few of us.
I came out of the gargoyle.

lines.zh: 你退开，别踩到我的同伴。
lines.en: Step back; don't step on my kin.

lines.zh: 我低吼，是提醒不是威胁。
lines.en: My growl is a warning, not a threat.
Put away that pickaxe.
I stay crouched on the wall, watching.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，我跳到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, I hop along.
I flatten down, like a stone.

lines.zh: 你抬头的次数越来越多了。
lines.en: You're looking up more often now.
I wait for you to pass beneath me.
I shift closer.
You're inside; I'm on the lintel.
I mean no harm, only menace.
You've stopped looking. Good.

lines.zh: 几只同类在另一头等你。
lines.en: A few of mine wait at the other end.

lines.zh: 雷电一响我才从石头里出来。
lines.en: I only leave the stone when lightning strikes.
When I drop, don't just stand there.
One slap of my paw hits your shoulder.
Stone against a person is very solid.
I sit on you and pin you down.

lines.zh: 这一下留着灰，没什么伤。
lines.en: That left dust, not much harm.
I bite your glove.
The knock pushes you two steps back.
I only want you to move along.
My claws rake the flagstones.
Punch me and your hand will hurt.

lines.zh: 这一下不怎么疼，可很丢人。
lines.en: That barely hurt, but it's humiliating.

lines.zh: 雷打在石像鬼上，我出来了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the gargoyle and out I come.
A mouth splits open in the stone.

lines.zh: 闪电劈下，石像裂开了嘴。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; the gargoyle's mouth splits open.

lines.zh: 先是磨石的声音，然后是我。
lines.en: First the sound of grinding, then me.
I land and dust rises.
A few come out with me.
The walls here are good for climbing.
I look around for bugs.
I shake off the grit.

lines.zh: 石像鬼的嘴里还留着光。
lines.en: Light still lingers in the gargoyle's mouth.
Fire on stone. I'm not afraid.
The landing rattles even me.

lines.zh: 水渗进缝里，我沉下去了。
lines.en: Water seeps in and I go down.

lines.zh: 炸开的碎石全打在我身上。
lines.en: The shattered stone all hits me.
The arrowhead snaps on my hide.
Light gets into my cracks and burns.

lines.zh: 没有蠹虫吃，我越来越沉。
lines.en: No silverfish to eat; I grow heavier.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I light up all over.
Even stone falls, and keeps falling.
